about: Attachments and voice notes vs the server's upload limit (QOL A08.2; voice notes §6). size = the file's bytes, limit = the server's m.upload.size (null = unknown: never refused). over = refused before anything is read or uploaded, with "That file is too large for the server" (a voice note: "This voice message is too large for the server"). Replayed by the desktop (room.rs voice_over_limit) and Tin Hat Web (src/features/chat/lib/uploadLimit.ts overUploadLimit).

cases.name: a zero limit is no limit
